reason: Keep baking off by default. Copper loses 7.9% FPS with the 8 m preset, versus a 1.17% pooled identical-code control spread. Nature improves 4.25% in the main run but only 0.83% in its independent repeat near the presentation ceiling. There is no established general FPS benefit to offset memory and image costs.
limits: Single machine, medium lighting, shadows off; no cross-browser speed ranking.
Settled horizon and turning views; startup, uploads, PNG capture, and transitions excluded from FPS.
Control spread is an observed order/session effect, not a confidence interval or a correction to subtract.
CPU durations are quantized to milliseconds. GPU spans are pass envelopes and overlap CPU work.
Distance 384 m and cache 32 MiB were fixed, not globally optimized.
